answer: A time-lock mechanism mitigates Sybil attacks in decentralized agent networks. Enrolling agents solve sequential delay functions seeded by an entropy beacon, logging periodic proofs into a shared topological atlas. An attacker incurs the non-parallelizable cost of sustained processor runtime and electrical power for each forged persona. However, transient propagation delays can prevent valid proofs from arriving in time, temporarily excluding honest agents from the trusted haven.
